answer: At each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and registers a Semaphore commitment to a secret identity key. It evaluates the epoch polynomial, deriving an RLN rate-limit share for every authenticated message; duplicate messaging exposes inconsistent shares, enabling Shamir reconstruction of the private key and a proof-triggered, instantaneous collateral slashing. Domain-separated tags—dawn, quartz, and ripple—prevent cross-epoch replay and reinforce Sybil resistance.
